stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) analysis for the 5000-frame industrial control telemetry. The analysis followed the laboratory protocol by splitting the trajectory into five 1000-frame blocks and computing TSI using the lab's compute_tsi function. Results: Block 1 TSI=0.917065, Block 2 TSI=0.959602, Block 3 TSI=0.907719, Block 4 TSI=0.899062, Block 5 TSI=0.911682. The definitive full-trace TSI (arithmetic mean) is 0.919026, indicating high temporal stability throughout the observation period. All deliverables completed: analysis code, intermediate results, 4 publication-quality figures, and comprehensive report.
